title: Text
concept: Str holds text — sequences of characters wrapped in double quotes.
why: Programs need to handle names, messages, and data. Str is how you work with text.
tips: Strings always use double quotes `""`, never single quotes
An empty string `""` is valid — it's like an empty box
Use `\n` inside a string to create a new line when printed
common_mistakes: Using single quotes: `'hello'` is for Char, not Str
Forgetting quotes entirely: `let x: Str = hello;` won't work
